note: Giles County's zoning districts are only reachable through the county's interactive GIS (gilescova.interactivegis.com), which requires a login; no public ArcGIS REST zoning layer was found. The webgis.net viewer printout shows zoning but exposes no public service. Pearisburg publishes its zoning map only as a 2012 PDF (viewer-only); the Town of Narrows zoning web map is a personal ArcGIS Online item with no service URL. The county ordinance is PDF text only.
